visual_identity.core_identity: A normal-looking weapon animated by magic, flying and attacking with no hand, arm, or visible wielder.
visual_identity.silhouette: Single sword suspended horizontally or diagonally in open air with a clear motion arc.
visual_identity.body_shape: One complete sword with blade, guard, grip, and pommel; the weapon itself is the creature.
visual_identity.surface: Clean metal blade and simple hilt with minimal decorative marks.
